fact_text: On 2 June 2025 the government finalised an arrangement with 18 banks to finance about Rs 1.275 trillion of power-sector circular debt, which the analyst said would clear a large part of the inter-corporate debt.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'Midday Flash 2 June 2025 | TOMCL Analysis | Govt Finalizes Rs 1.275 Trillion Power Sector Loan' (YouTube, 2025-06-02)

fact_text: The analyst says the full size of the circular-debt financing package could reach about Rs 2.3 trillion, which he expects to ease inter-corporate debt problems for large Pakistani companies over time.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'Midday Flash 2 June 2025 | TOMCL Analysis | Govt Finalizes Rs 1.275 Trillion Power Sector Loan' (YouTube, 2025-06-02)

fact_text: The bank financing is expected to carry a tenor of roughly five to six years, with repayments made in smaller instalments of about Rs 50-60 billion as collections come in.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'Midday Flash 2 June 2025 | TOMCL Analysis | Govt Finalizes Rs 1.275 Trillion Power Sector Loan' (YouTube, 2025-06-02)

fact_text: The analyst says PSO's legacy circular-debt receivables in its books are about Rs 450-500 billion, and that PSO could be cleared first from the bank-financed package in small tranches.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'Midday Flash 2 June 2025 | TOMCL Analysis | Govt Finalizes Rs 1.275 Trillion Power Sector Loan' (YouTube, 2025-06-02)

fact_text: Legacy receivables of about Rs 500-600 billion are cited for the upstream gas producers OGDC and PPL, owed by the gas pipeline and utility chain, and the analyst expects these to be collected as the package is paid out.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'Midday Flash 2 June 2025 | TOMCL Analysis | Govt Finalizes Rs 1.275 Trillion Power Sector Loan' (YouTube, 2025-06-02)

fact_text: The analyst sees the circular-debt settlement as a catalyst for higher cash collections at the upstream gas companies OGDC and PPL, which would benefit them as the chain clears receivables.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'Midday Flash 2 June 2025 | TOMCL Analysis | Govt Finalizes Rs 1.275 Trillion Power Sector Loan' (YouTube, 2025-06-02)

fact_text: In June 2025 the system held a gas surplus: Pakistan diverted six RLNG cargoes, and industry shifting to the national grid reduced gas demand, so the analyst saw limited near-term need for gas.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'Midday Flash 2 June 2025 | TOMCL Analysis | Govt Finalizes Rs 1.275 Trillion Power Sector Loan' (YouTube, 2025-06-02)

fact_text: The Organic Meat Company exports frozen meat only, with markets in China, Saudi Arabia, the UAE and other Gulf countries, and older-animal meat sold to Azerbaijan.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'Midday Flash 2 June 2025 | TOMCL Analysis | Govt Finalizes Rs 1.275 Trillion Power Sector Loan' (YouTube, 2025-06-02)

fact_text: The analyst describes The Organic Meat Company as Pakistan's largest meat exporter and says its export order book is strong as Eid-ul-Adha demand approaches.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'Midday Flash 2 June 2025 | TOMCL Analysis | Govt Finalizes Rs 1.275 Trillion Power Sector Loan' (YouTube, 2025-06-02)

fact_text: The Organic Meat Company has equity of about Rs 6 billion and long-term debt of under Rs 1 billion, with most borrowing short-term, per the analyst's review of the nine-month accounts.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'Midday Flash 2 June 2025 | TOMCL Analysis | Govt Finalizes Rs 1.275 Trillion Power Sector Loan' (YouTube, 2025-06-02)

fact_text: The Organic Meat Company completed a rights issue at Rs 27 per share, and the stock was trading at about Rs 31 by early June 2025, which the analyst said could draw investor attention.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'Midday Flash 2 June 2025 | TOMCL Analysis | Govt Finalizes Rs 1.275 Trillion Power Sector Loan' (YouTube, 2025-06-02)

fact_text: PSO reportedly claims about PKR 800 billion of circular debt, according to media reports, while the analyst said the books show legacy debt of roughly PKR 450 to 500 billion.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'Midday Flash 2 June 2025 | TOMCL Analysis | Govt Finalizes Rs 1.275 Trillion Power Sector Loan' (YouTube, 2025-06-02)

fact_text: TOMCL reported nine-month EPS of about PKR 2.65 in FY25.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'Midday Flash 2 June 2025 | TOMCL Analysis | Govt Finalizes Rs 1.275 Trillion Power Sector Loan' (YouTube, 2025-06-02)
